name: Surround fusion asynchronous public self-check v1
location_reference: CARLA bounding-box center in base_link at the original LiDAR acquisition timestamp; metres, x forward, y left.
review_method: Codex visual review of 90 actual asynchronous camera images and actor-box projections. Body support uses 10 cm box tolerance, excluding the lowest 20 cm above the box bottom. No instructor sign-off implied.
review_coverage: 15 scan keyframes at four-second intervals, from 2 to 58 seconds of the released recording. Repeated views of a small number of actors; not a full-sequence benchmark.
